earlierFailures: Initial E2E run collided with another worktree's default Vite HMR port and reported WebSocket closed without opened. Fixed by serving HMR on the branch's HTTP server.

Offline regression expected Playwright offline toggle to immediately close an established WebSocket. It did not. Test now explicitly closes the transport while offline and checks reconnection.
Per-25ms-window snapshot assertion was flaky because the window could span two callbacks. Corrected to assert per-callback emission count; final unit suite passed.
An after benchmark ran concurrently with E2E and was discarded. Final reports after.json and final.json were measured with that suite stopped.
